name: Cua Driver
summary: See when an agent drives your Mac, and stop it
description:
Cua Driver shows when a coding agent is driving your Mac through cua-driver, and stops it.

While an agent drives, its name sits beside the notch, with a record mark while it records the screen. A card on the notch says when a new agent starts.

The shelf widget lists every session the driver is running: what kind of client it is, when it started, how long ago it last acted, and a Stop button for each. Stop every agent from the widget's header, from a keyboard shortcut that works in any app, or from a script with droppy://droplet/cuadriver/stop. Stopping only revokes a session: it never grants one anything.

Settings shows whether the driver is running, its version, the permission mode it runs in, and whether it has Accessibility and Screen Recording.

Needs cua-driver on this Mac (cua-driver serve).
